description: Source code implementing functions for inserting and converting constant values in Torch JIT IR, including handling of tensors, IValues, and various data types.

methods.name: insertableTensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor can be inserted as a constant, i.e., it has storage, is not requiring gradients, and is not nested.

methods.name: insertableIValue
methods.description: Determines if an IValue is suitable for insertion as a constant based on its type and contents.

methods.name: tryInsertConstant
methods.description: Attempts to create a constant node from an IValue, returning an optional Value*.

methods.name: insertConstant
methods.description: Inserts a constant node into the graph from an IValue, with optional source location and scope.

methods.name: toIValue
methods.description: Converts a constant Value* back to an IValue if possible.
